Appearance:

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD

sentences.text: The present application is filed by the applicant seeking grant of transit bail in connection with the offence registered being Crime No. 09 of 2022 with C E N Crime, Police Station, Bidar, State - Karnataka for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 408, 419, 420, 465, 468, 471 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. Heard learned advocate Mr.Y.J.Patel for the applicant and learned APP Mr.Bhargav Pandya for the respondent - State.
3.
Learned Advocate Mr.Patel submits that the Applicant is desirous of obtaining appropriate relief by resorting to appropriate proceedings before the Court at Karnataka.
He therefore submits to allow the present Application and grant transit bail to the Applicant for a period of 30 days.
The Application is opposed by learned APP Mr.Bhargav Pandya.
5. In view of the aforesaid submissions canvassed by learned advocate for the applicant and looking to the peculiar facts and circumstances of the present case, this application is partly-allowed.
